source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Duet Sport Front-Load Dryer (Job Aid L-79)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Access thermal cut-off
steps.body: Remove toe panel. Locate thermal cut-off per Figure 11.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove toe panel. Locate thermal cut-off per Figure 11.

steps.title: Thermal cut-off continuity
steps.body: Does the thermal cut-off show continuity (0 Ω)? Open = replace cut-off and high-limit thermostat; check vent path and heater (electric).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Does the thermal cut-off show continuity (0 Ω)? Open = replace cut-off and high-limit thermostat; check vent path and heater (electric).

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace thermal cut-off and high-limit thermostat; inspect exhaust and heater.

steps.title: Replace cut-off & high-limit
steps.oemOutcome: Replace thermal cut-off and high-limit thermostat.
